name: YB
recent: YB 于 2026 年 9 月完成 ICULS 到期强制转换，发行约 9780 万股新股，股本扩大至约 3.92 亿股。公司将于 2026 年 12 月 30 日召开第 26 届常年股东大会，并已发布 2026 年报。近期董事及大股东 Datuk Au Yee Boon 申报持股变动，同时董事在闭市期前表示有意交易股票。
notable: ICULS 到期强制转换，发行 97,805,101 股新股，上市日为 2026 年 9 月 7 日。
将于 2026 年 12 月 30 日召开第 26 届常年股东大会。
2026 年报及企业治理报告已发布。
risks: ICULS 转换导致股本显著扩大，可能摊薄现有股东权益。
董事在闭市期前表示有意交易公司股票。
董事及大股东 Datuk Au Yee Boon 申报持股变动。

recent_en: YB completed the mandatory conversion of its ICULS upon maturity in September 2026, issuing about 97.8 million new shares and enlarging its share base to approximately 391.9 million shares. Recently, Director and major shareholder Datuk Au Yee Boon reported changes in his shareholding, and a director indicated an intention to deal in shares during the closed period.
notable_en: Mandatory conversion of ICULS upon maturity, issuing 97,805,101 new shares with listing date on 7 September 2026.
26th Annual General Meeting scheduled for 30 December 2026.
Annual Report and Corporate Governance Report for 2026 have been released.
risks_en: The ICULS conversion significantly enlarged the share base, potentially diluting existing shareholders.
A director indicated an intention to deal in the company's shares during the closed period.
Director and major shareholder Datuk Au Yee Boon reported changes in his shareholding.
